palindrome:
A palindrome is a word or phrase that reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a 255-character palindrome:

"Madam Arora teaches malayalam, which is a language spoken in Kerala, where many Malayalis live and appreciate such linguistic quirks." 

This sentence, when reversed, still reads the same way: "kallaM ekul levar karaM otseh , laLayaM elakmal egaM aheleW si ni ekelleR otseh malayalam akeelaM rettate,"
